values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/springlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Spring Lake State Forest Campground, Grand Traverse: rustic, 'open all year', managed by Mitchell SP 231-775-7911, 30 sites, $20, ORV operation between SFCG and trails allowed no, boat ramp R, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/springlake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/springlake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 32 'tent and small trailer sites' on the DNR page (the DNR amenity table says 30); no length posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/springlake ('this rustic campground offers 32 tent and small trailer sites'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (30 campsites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Campground roads may not be plowed in winter.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Spring Lake: 'Seasonal closure dates: open all year'; '*Please note: SFCG campground roads may not be plowed in the winter.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on a heavily wooded, rolling hill overlooking Spring Lake (canal access to Fife Lake), 2 mi SW of Fife Lake via US-131. Ramp access to Spring Lake inside the campground; pike and panfish. Direct access to the North Country Trail and the 21-mile Fife Lake Loop. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, year-round (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Changed max stay 14 -> 15 days; cleared the derived 50-ft max_rig_ft (Campendium only; DNR says 'tent and small trailer', the standard wording, silent on length). Sites 32 per the page (table says 30). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation to trails 'no'; not an ORV trail camp. Directions (US-131) carry no road warning. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements and the Campendium length.
